shortDescription: Module for setup of RateLimitConfiguration Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: burst
options.description: The maximum request per second(rps) user intends to support for this category.this is not guaranteed as this will be the minimum of the rps supported by the resources in the category and this value.if user doesnt provide then it will be minimum value of the resources in this category. Allowed values are 1-1000. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controlle

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Description for the rate limit configuration. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: http_methods
options.description: List of http method(s) of the resources that need to be rate limited. Enum options - HTTP_METHOD_GET, HTTP_METHOD_HEAD, HTTP_METHOD_PUT, HTTP_METHOD_DELETE, HTTP_METHOD_POST, HTTP_METHOD_OPTIONS, HTTP_METHOD_TRACE, HTTP_METHOD_CONNECT, HTTP_METHOD_PATCH, HTTP_METHOD_PROPFIND, HTTP_METHOD_PROPPATCH, HTTP_METHOD_MKCOL, HTTP_METHOD_COPY, HTTP_METHOD_MOVE, HTTP_METHOD_LOCK, HTTP_METHOD_UNLOCK. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Minimum of 1 items required. Maximum of 5 items allowed. Allowed with any value

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the rate limit configuration(unique). Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: resource
options.description: Ratelimitresource which needs to be rate limited. Enum options - RATE_LIMIT_VIRTUALSERVICE, RATE_LIMIT_POOL, RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN, RATE_LIMIT_AUTHTOKEN, RATE_LIMIT_HEALTHMONITOR. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: Tenant ref for the auth rate limit configuration. It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: token_refill_rate
options.description: Token refill rate. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the rate limiter, for now we only support api categorization based. Enum options - RATE_LIMITER_API_CATEGORY. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as RATE_LIMITER_API_CATEGORY.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the rate limit configuration. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.
